Information to pre-paid consumers on activation of a voucher ------ Every service provider shall, within 4[seventy five days] from the date of issue of these regulations, immediately on activation of a voucher, provide through SMS to the pre-paid consumer the following information:- (a) on activation of Plan Voucher:- (i) title of the plan; and (ii) validity period of the plan; (b) on activation of Top Up Voucher:- (i) total amount charged; (ii) processing fee or administration charge as the case
title: 01 telecom consumers protection
